salmanshh_virtual_cursor.name: Virtual Cursor
salmanshh_virtual_cursor.description: Turns any world object into a fully controllable virtual cursor. Driven entirely through events, movement input, interact presses, homing magnet, and solid collision all exposed via ACEs. Supports gamepad,keyboard, touch, and automated input with configurable acceleration,deceleration, and max speed.

maxSpeed.name: Max Speed
maxSpeed.desc: Maximum cursor movement speed in pixels per second.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.desc: Rate of acceleration toward max speed, in pixels per second squared.

deceleration.name: Deceleration
deceleration.desc: Rate of deceleration when axis input is zero, in pixels per second squared.

directionMode.name: Directions
directionMode.desc: Limits the axes the cursor can move along. Up & Down disables horizontal movement; Left & Right disables vertical movement; 4 Directions snaps to the dominant axis; 8 Directions allows full free movement.

allowSliding.name: Allow Sliding
allowSliding.desc: When enabled, the cursor slides along solid obstacles rather than stopping on contact. When disabled, all velocity is zeroed on any solid hit.

defaultControls.name: Default Controls
defaultControls.desc: If enabled, arrow keys control movement. Otherwise, use the Simulate Control actions to drive movement from the event sheet.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is initially enabled or disabled.

AddHomingTarget.description: Registers picked instances as homing targets the cursor steers toward.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to add as homing targets

ClearHomingTargets.description: Removes all homing targets and resets the in-range state.

RemoveHomingTarget.description: Removes picked instances of an object from the homing targets list.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to remove from homing targets

SetHomingEnabled.description: Enables or disables the homing magnet system.

SetHomingMode.description: Steer pulls the cursor gently toward the nearest target; Snap locks it directly on the target.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Steer = gentle pull, Snap = instant lock-on

SetHomingRadius.description: Sets the homing detection radius in pixels.

SetHomingStrength.description: Sets the pull strength used by Steer mode (0–1). Snap mode ignores this value.

PressInteract.description: Marks the named interact input as held and fires On Interact Pressed. Use a consistent ID string (e.g. "interact", "fire", "jump") to distinguish between multiple buttons.

ReleaseInteract.description: Clears the named interact input held state and fires On Interact Released. The ID must match the one used in Press Interact.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier — must match the ID used in Press Interact

SetAcceleration.description: Sets how fast the cursor speeds up when input is held, in px/s².

SetDeceleration.description: Sets how fast the cursor slows down when no input is held, in px/s².

SetMaxSpeed.description: Sets the maximum movement speed in pixels per second.

SetPosition.description: Instantly teleports the cursor object to the given position.

SetVelocity.description: Directly sets the cursor velocity in pixels per second.

MoveToward.description: Sets the movement axis toward a target position. Call every tick to follow a moving target such as the mouse.

SimulateAxis.description: Intended for analog sticks and virtual joysticks.

x.name: Axis X
x.desc: Horizontal axis value. Typical range -1 to 1; values outside are normalised down to unit length.

y.name: Axis Y
y.desc: Vertical axis value. Typical range -1 to 1; values outside are normalised down to unit length.

SimulateControl.description: Moves the cursor in a direction this tick only. Must be called every tick it should remain held.

SimulateInteract.description: Fires On Interact Pressed and On Interact Released for the given ID within the same frame. Does not set the held state. Use Press Interact + Release Interact separately when held state is needed.

SimulateMouse.description: Smoothly moves the cursor toward a target position each tick. Unlike Move Toward, uses exponential velocity smoothing for a natural ease-in and ease-out with no sudden stops. Call every tick.

smoothing.name: Smoothing
smoothing.desc: Follow responsiveness from 0 (frozen) to 1 (instant). Values around 0.1–0.3 feel like a smooth mouse cursor.

AddSolid.description: Registers picked instances as solids the cursor is pushed out of.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to add as solids

ClearSolids.description: Removes all explicit solids from the solids list.

RemoveSolid.description: Removes picked instances of an object from the solids list.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to remove from solids

SetAllowSliding.description: When enabled, only the velocity component perpendicular to the collision wall is zeroed — the cursor slides along the surface. When disabled, all velocity is zeroed on any solid hit.

state.name: State
state.desc: Enable or disable sliding along solid obstacles

SetSolidCollision.description: Enables or disables automatic solid collision for all Solid behavior instances.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether automatic solid collision is active

SetConstraintBounds.description: Sets a custom constraint rectangle. Pass all zeros to reset to full layout bounds.

SetConstrainToLayout.description: Clamps cursor inside layout bounds and fires On Layout Edge Hit.

SetDefaultControls.description: Enable or disable the built-in arrow key controls. When disabled, use the Simulate Control action to drive movement from the event sheet.

state.name: Enabled
state.desc: Enable or disable default arrow key controls

SetDirectionMode.description: Limits the axes the cursor can move along. Up & Down disables horizontal movement; Left & Right disables vertical movement; 4 Directions snaps to the dominant axis per tick; 8 Directions allows full free movement.

SetEnabled.description: Enables or disables the Virtual Cursor behavior.

IsInHomingRange.description: True when at least one homing target is within the homing radius.

OnHomingSnapped.description: Fires when the cursor teleports to a homing target in Snap mode.

OnHomingTargetEntered.description: Fires when the cursor enters the homing radius of a target.

OnHomingTargetExited.description: Fires when the cursor leaves the homing radius of all targets.

IsInteractHeld.description: True while the named interact input is pressed and not yet released. Leave ID empty to check if any interact input is currently held.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier, or empty string to check if any interact is held

OnInteractPressed.description: Fires when Press Interact is called for the given ID. Leave ID empty to fire for any interact press.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier to filter on, or leave empty to match any

OnInteractReleased.description: Fires when Release Interact is called for the given ID. Leave ID empty to fire for any interact release.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier to filter on, or leave empty to match any

IsMoving.description: True if the cursor has non-zero velocity.

OnLayoutEdgeHit.description: Fires when the cursor hits the layout boundary while constrained.

IsBlocked.display-text: Was blocked by a solid this tick
IsBlocked.description: True if the cursor was pushed out of a solid object this tick.

OnSolidHit.description: Fires when the cursor collides with a solid object and is pushed out.

IsEnabled.description: True if the VectorCursor behavior is currently active.

CountHomingTargets.description: Returns the total number of registered homing targets.

GetHomingTargetUIDByIndex.description: Returns the UID of a registered homing target by index, or -1.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index into the homing targets list

HomingTargetDist.description: Returns distance to the nearest in-range homing target, or -1.

HomingTargetUID.description: Returns the UID of the nearest in-range homing target, or -1.

AxisX.description: Returns the current horizontal axis input value (-1 to 1).

AxisY.description: Returns the current vertical axis input value (-1 to 1).

CursorX.description: Returns the current X position of the cursor object.

CursorY.description: Returns the current Y position of the cursor object.

MovingAngle.description: Returns the current movement angle in degrees based on the cursor's velocity vector.

Speed.description: Returns the cursor's current movement speed in pixels per second.

VelocityX.description: Returns the current horizontal velocity in pixels per second.

VelocityY.description: Returns the current vertical velocity in pixels per second.

CountSolids.description: Returns the total number of registered explicit solids.

SolidUID.description: Returns the UID of the last solid hit this tick, or -1.

ConstraintBottom.description: Returns the bottom edge of the active constraint region.

ConstraintLeft.description: Returns the left edge of the active constraint region.

ConstraintRight.description: Returns the right edge of the active constraint region.

ConstraintTop.description: Returns the top edge of the active constraint region.
